title: 脚付き業務用二槽流し台
description: 食堂・厨房の洗浄区画へ置く脚付き二槽流し台。深い二つの鉢と実開口の排水口、アーチ水栓と開いた吐水端、背立て、四脚と下部補強、下の排水管・U字トラップを造形。壁・給排水設備は付属せず、現場の位置へ配置する一式1点です。水流や弁操作は実装していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.310 × 1.273 × 0.727 m、11,672三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A freestanding double sink for cafeteria and commercial-kitchen wash areas, with two deep bowls and actual drain openings, arched faucets with open outlets, backsplash, four legs/lower bracing, drain pipes and visible U traps. Wall and building plumbing are not included; place the whole single assembly as needed. Water flow and valve operation are not implemented. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.310 × 1.273 × 0.727 m; 11,672 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
